decision: Add one new catalogue package can.std.test@1 holding every base owner, workspace, process and evidence operation with opaque non-constructible handle types; one catalogue operation per allowed native call (the inventory is the dispatch allowlist); one emitter contribution to $canTest targets built by runtime/test-support/owner.ts and transport.ts; forged handles fail table lookup, stale handles fail liveness lookup.
interpretation: Three fresh phrasings favor single_test_package (0.80, 0.92, 0.82). Agreement is advisory only; the choice is independently supported by the domain-contribution emitter pattern, the two-factory runtime layout named in P28's file list, and the acceptance requirement that arbitrary dispatch/eval be unrepresentable. It does not prove correctness or remove bias, and authorizes no execution or qualification.
